# https://abhinavkarn.in/

## About
Abhinav Karn is an independent AI & software developer building local-first
AI assistants, web tools, and experimental technology. The portfolio is built
in the open and all projects link to GitHub (https://github.com/KarnAbhinav00).

## Featured projects
- STONY — local-first AI assistant with conversation memory and tool use (Python, Ollama)
- STARK Counter — connected AI control center that unifies models, projects, and tools (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
- Inspire MANAK Assist Vision — computer-vision assistive prototype with embedded hardware and audio feedback
- Kãl — dark, atmospheric 2D horror game concept (Blender, Game design)
- Neon Racer X — futuristic arcade racing prototype (Game development, Blender)
